value.text: ASK from the Tether prime pij-causal-salamander for Vaughan (brief copied to original-ask.md). ETA sent 06:15Z: PR open + CI green by ~19:45 AEDT (CS-3, code, est 150 min); M4 Max 16C (12P+4E) 128 GB; worker claude-opus-5.5 (effort xhigh). Worktree pij-prime-watchdog-start from origin/main d459dda.

RED against a stub surface (new fields, a phase() that always says every, a no-op end_watchdog_start, a parser that ignores --start): core start/nudge tests, parser tests, the store migration test and four daemon tests failed; the existing --every test passed. Evidence: evidence/red.txt.

GREEN. Migration 0031 (start_secs CHECK NULL or > 0, started_at), SCHEMA_VERSION 31; WatchdogOptIn.phase()/active_interval_secs(); the round reads report.now for the start edge, persists the end before the start nudge (a record that does not land sends nothing), records a report-ended phase; handler parses --start (1m floor, on only), identical re-arm is a no-op, status adds phase/active_interval_secs live. fmt and clippy -D warnings clean; pij-core, pij-store, pij-daemon (integration) and pij-cli green; 7 pij-daemon lib timing tests failed in parallel at load1 8-28 and passed 7/7 serially. pij-skill-check failure set identical to main. Mutants MW1-MW12 all killed. Evidence: green.txt, mutation.txt.

FINDING (pre-existing, not changed): the opt-in round's seats come from registry.list, which never fills last_event_at (only the status projection does). So an opted-in seat's quiet is measured from arming and the round's in-memory nudge times, not from its last event as pij-rs-api.md says. Plan 184's start edge reads report.now directly, so it is unaffected; a seat that reports at 19m is still nudged at 20m after arming. Reported to the owner, not fixed here.
